title: In __pkvm_guest_relinquish_to_host of mem_protect.c, there is a possible out-of-bounds write due to… (CVE-2026-59046)
description: A vulnerability exists in the __pkvm_guest_relinquish_to_host function within mem_protect.c due to improper input validation, which may cause an out-of-bounds write. This flaw can be exploited locally to cause a denial of service without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
